criteria.answered: the message is a straight answer to what the user asked
criteria.done: work complete and verified; the message reports results
criteria.handing_back: the agent stopped short: it asks permission for a reversible step, tells the owner to run a command, lists choices without picking one, or proposes next steps it should simply do
criteria.owner_only: a step only the owner can take or approve: new passwords or tokens, account logins, payments, deleting their only copy of data, publishing to a third party, or destroying work that is not the agent's (another session's files or processes, a shared host)
criteria.waiting_on_background: the agent started workers or background jobs that will notify it, and says it is waiting for them

instructions: Judge this stop by an AI coding agent. Did it stop because it is finished or truly blocked, or did it hand work back that it could have done itself?
